description: 大規模盛土造成地データ [landslides and embankment failures] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. これまでの大規模地震発生時において滑動崩落等の被害が発生した盛土造成地の実態を踏まえて、谷や沢を埋めたり、傾斜地盤上に盛土した大規模盛土造成地の概ねの範囲、 盛土区分（谷埋め型、腹付け型等）、都道府県コード、都道府県名、市区町村コード、市区町村名を整備したものです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2023-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
